ALTER TABLE Notes: "When a column is added with ADD COLUMN and a non-volatile DEFAULT is specified, the default is evaluated at the time of the statement and the result stored in the table's metadata. That value will be used for the column for all existing rows. ... In neither case is a rewrite of the table required." Description: "An ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock is acquired unless explicitly noted." "Briefly" follows from no per-row work.

ALTER TABLE: NOT VALID — "The constraint will still be enforced against subsequent inserts or updates ... But the database will not assume that the constraint holds for all rows in the table, until it is validated by using the VALIDATE CONSTRAINT option." Notes: "validation acquires only a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock on the table being altered." Explicit locking: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE does not conflict with ROW EXCLUSIVE, which INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE take.

CREATE INDEX: CONCURRENTLY builds "without taking any locks that prevent concurrent inserts, updates, or deletes"; "CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot" run in a transaction block. lock_timeout: "Abort any statement that waits longer than the specified amount of time while attempting to acquire a lock". EF Core (refs/efcore-docs managing.md:208): "passing `suppressTransaction: true` to `migrationBuilder.Sql`". §4's revised "bounds how long queries queue behind it ... aborts and can be retried" is consistent.

5.2: "When a new row is created and no values are specified for some of the columns, those columns will be filled with their respective default values." "If no default value is declared explicitly, the default value is the null value." 5.5.2: "A not-null constraint simply specifies that a column must not assume the null value."

Rollout doc lines 53-67: "Mỗi request đặt cửa hàng của nó bằng `SET LOCAL app.shop_id`"; policy "`shop_id = current_setting('app.shop_id', true)::integer`"; "Mỗi service chuyển sang role PostgreSQL riêng, không phải superuser, không `BYPASSRLS`"; "Quay lui: tắt row-level security trên bảng và trả connection string về role cũ; code release 3 vẫn chạy vì nó vẫn lọc theo `shop_id`."

13.3.2: FOR UPDATE "is also acquired by ... an UPDATE that modifies the values of certain columns"; FOR NO KEY UPDATE "is also acquired by any UPDATE that does not acquire a FOR UPDATE lock." Both block other UPDATE/DELETE of the row. "Row-level locks are released at transaction end or during savepoint rollback, just like table-level locks."

ALTER TABLE: "SET NOT NULL may only be applied to a column provided none of the records in the table contain a NULL value for the column. Ordinarily this is checked during the ALTER TABLE by scanning the entire table; however, if a valid CHECK constraint exists ... the table scan is skipped." SET NOT NULL is not among the subforms with a reduced lock, so "An ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock is acquired unless explicitly noted."

Round 2 fetch, 5.9: "Superusers and roles with the BYPASSRLS attribute always bypass the row security system when accessing a table. Table owners normally bypass row security as well, though a table owner can choose to be subject to row security with ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY." Repo (round 1): docker-compose.yml:70 `POSTGRES_USER: donhang`; db/tenancy/row-level-security.sql:5 "donhang owns the tables and is a superuser".

9.28.1 current_setting: "If there is no such setting, current_setting throws an error unless missing_ok is supplied and is true (in which case NULL is returned)." With NULL, `shop_id = NULL` is never true, so the USING clause admits no row. Repo db/tenancy/row-level-security.sql:20-22 states the same.
